title: Schema cleaning drops typed dictionary value schemas
reasoning: Pydantic emits object map fields such as dict[str, NestedModel] or dict[str, int] using additionalProperties as a schema object. _clean_schema only preserves additionalProperties when it is a bool, so typed map fields lose their value schema in the generated tool spec. That weakens or breaks the model-facing parameter contract for SDK tools with dictionary arguments.
recommendation: Preserve additionalProperties when it is a dict by recursively cleaning that nested schema, while keeping the existing bool handling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and the implementation only covers bool additionalProperties, indicating typed map schemas are not asserted.
suggestedRegressionTest: Define a Tool args_model with a field like mapping: dict[str, int] or dict[str, NestedArgs], build the tool spec, and assert parameters.properties.mapping.additionalProperties retains the cleaned value schema.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/sdk/tool.py and a focused SDK schema-generation test.
